Photo and film exhibit on Liberation War
2014-11-12T00:00:57+06:00 | Aminul Islam, Mymensingh
https://www.thedailystar.net/photo-and-film-exhibit-on-liberation-war-49825

Hundreds of people gathered at Haluaghat Model High School ground recently at a photography exhibition and screening of films on Liberation War. Alokchitra Shilpi Sangsad (Ashis) Mymensingh organised the photography exhibition to inspire the young generation.

More than 100 photos on Liberation War, mostly snapped by internationally reputed photographer late Naibuddin Ahmed, were displayed at the exhibition.

Films on the Liberation War, including "Aguner Poroshmoni", were screened as a way of having the audience experience the historic events leading to the emergence of Bangladesh.

AKM Mozammel Haque, MP, minister for Liberation War Affairs inaugurated the event as chief guest. A discussion titled “Motivate the new generation about the spirit of Liberation War” was held marking the occasion. Md Anwar Hossain, commander of Muktijuddah Sangsad Mymensingh delivered the welcome speech while Haluaghat Upazila Commander Kabirul Islam Beig presided.

Harun-ur-Rashid, deputy commander of the organisation read out a keynote paper titled “Bangabandhu, Muktijuddho O Bangladesh”.
